source: Real MySQL and Spring Boot; synthetic input; deterministic RULE provider

checks.name: published followup policy is frozen and owner protected
vague answer produces one neutral clarification with real source ID
specific context is skipped without length-only threshold
new self-raised social cue can be explored with a literal quote
skipped followup never reopens or overwrites original answer
explicit refusal and privacy risk stop before any provider
no AI consent means no provider call and normal core submission works
global budget is enforced under concurrent different-question requests
same-question concurrent retries only create one decision and one charge
supplement is independently persisted and attached to the real submitted answer
invalid or foreign session and question IDs are rejected
consent revocation closes outstanding prompts without reopening on retry
owner can trace source, state transitions, model policy and cost uncertainty
new published policy cannot alter old version snapshot or old answers
